CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

2. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

3. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

4. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 25
   D. 5

5. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 64

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

7. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 37
   C. 5
   D. 36

8. Solve for x: x + 4 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 8
   D. 9

9. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 6
   C. 5
   D. 12.5

10. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 24
   D. 11

11. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 31.7
   D. 37

12. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 55
   C. 22
   D. 32

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 20
   C. 30
   D. 75

15. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 90

16. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 81
   D. 9

17. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 13
   C. 17
   D. 15

18. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 121
   C. 11
   D. 122

19. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

20. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 7

21. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

22. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

23. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

24. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 42

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
